designationHistory.name: Lower Souris Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Lower Souris Migratory Waterfowl Refuge, about 40,000 acres in Bottineau and McHenry Counties, North Dakota, by Executive Order 7170.
designationHistory.note: Renamed Lower Souris National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416 (1940); later renamed J. Clark Salyer NWR (renaming date not verified here).

sources.name: FWS ServCat: Comprehensive Conservation Plan: Des Lacs, J. Clark Salyer and Upper Souris NWRs (2007)
